🔓 #MistralAI has released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 on #HuggingFace. Until now it was available only through the Mistral API; the full checkpoint can now be downloaded, self-hosted and fine-tuned.

🧠 A natively multimodal #MoE with ~1T total and ~52B active parameters per token, trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters
